body.en: You write SELECT first, but the database works FROM → JOIN → WHERE → GROUP BY → HAVING → SELECT → ORDER BY → LIMIT. That explains common errors: you cannot use a column alias from SELECT inside WHERE (WHERE runs earlier), but you can use it in ORDER BY (which runs later).
body.hi: आप पहले SELECT लिखते हो, पर डेटाबेस FROM → JOIN → WHERE → GROUP BY → HAVING → SELECT → ORDER BY → LIMIT चलाता है। इससे आम त्रुटियाँ समझ आती हैं: SELECT का उपनाम WHERE में इस्तेमाल नहीं कर सकते (WHERE पहले चलता है), पर ORDER BY में कर सकते हो (वह बाद में चलता है)।
body.hinglish: Tum pehle SELECT likhte ho, par database FROM → JOIN → WHERE → GROUP BY → HAVING → SELECT → ORDER BY → LIMIT chalata hai. Isse common errors samajh aate hain: SELECT ka alias WHERE mein use nahi kar sakte (WHERE pehle chalta hai), par ORDER BY mein kar sakte ho (woh baad mein chalta hai).

analogy.en: Like cooking: pick the ingredients (FROM), throw out spoiled ones (WHERE), chop what you need (SELECT), arrange on the plate (ORDER BY), serve three pieces (LIMIT).
analogy.hi: खाना पकाने जैसा: सामग्री लो (FROM), ख़राब फेंको (WHERE), ज़रूरी काटो (SELECT), थाली में सजाओ (ORDER BY), तीन टुकड़े परोसो (LIMIT)।
analogy.hinglish: Khaana pakane jaisa: ingredients lo (FROM), kharab phenko (WHERE), zaroori kaato (SELECT), thaali mein sajao (ORDER BY), teen tukde paroso (LIMIT).

realExample.en: An e-commerce search "phones under ₹15,000, cheapest first" is WHERE price < 15000 ORDER BY price LIMIT 20 behind the scenes.
realExample.hi: ई-कॉमर्स खोज "₹15,000 से कम के फ़ोन, सबसे सस्ता पहले" पर्दे के पीछे WHERE price < 15000 ORDER BY price LIMIT 20 है।
realExample.hinglish: E-commerce search "₹15,000 se kam ke phones, sabse sasta pehle" parde ke peeche WHERE price < 15000 ORDER BY price LIMIT 20 hai.

body.en: AND binds tighter than OR, so WHERE class = 9 OR class = 10 AND city = 'Pune' means 9 from anywhere, or 10 from Pune. Use brackets to say what you mean. NULL means unknown, so city = NULL is never true — write city IS NULL. And text comparison may be case-sensitive in some databases; this playground ignores case.
body.hi: AND, OR से ज़्यादा मज़बूती से बँधता है, तो WHERE class = 9 OR class = 10 AND city = 'Pune' का मतलब कहीं से भी 9, या पुणे से 10। जो मतलब है उसके लिए कोष्ठक लगाओ। NULL का मतलब अज्ञात, तो city = NULL कभी सच नहीं — city IS NULL लिखो। और कुछ डेटाबेस में पाठ तुलना बड़े-छोटे अक्षर पर निर्भर हो सकती है; यह खेल-मैदान अक्षर का आकार नज़रअंदाज़ करता है।
body.hinglish: AND, OR se zyaada mazbooti se bandhta hai, to WHERE class = 9 OR class = 10 AND city = 'Pune' ka matlab kahin se bhi 9, ya Pune se 10. Jo matlab hai uske liye brackets lagao. NULL ka matlab unknown, to city = NULL kabhi sach nahi — city IS NULL likho. Aur kuch databases mein text comparison case-sensitive ho sakta hai; yeh playground case ignore karta hai.

analogy.en: Like maths: 2 + 3 × 4 is 14, not 20. Brackets remove doubt.
analogy.hinglish: Maths jaisa: 2 + 3 × 4 = 14, 20 nahi. Brackets shak mitaate hain.

realExample.en: WHERE (class = 9 OR class = 10) AND city = 'Pune' returns only Pune students from Classes 9 and 10.
realExample.hi: WHERE (class = 9 OR class = 10) AND city = 'Pune' सिर्फ़ कक्षा 9 और 10 के पुणे वाले छात्र लौटाता है।
realExample.hinglish: WHERE (class = 9 OR class = 10) AND city = 'Pune' sirf Class 9 aur 10 ke Pune wale students lautata hai.

mission.en: Write three queries of your own in Free play: (1) students not from Pune, (2) science marks between 60 and 80, (3) the 5 lowest maths marks. Predict the row count before running each.
mission.hi: खुले अभ्यास में अपनी तीन क्वेरी लिखो: (1) पुणे के अलावा छात्र, (2) 60 से 80 के बीच विज्ञान अंक, (3) गणित के 5 सबसे कम अंक। चलाने से पहले हर एक की पंक्ति-संख्या का अनुमान लगाओ।
mission.hinglish: Free play mein apni teen queries likho: (1) Pune ke alawa students, (2) 60 se 80 ke beech science marks, (3) maths ke 5 sabse kam marks. Chalane se pehle har ek ki row count ka andaaza lagao.

prompt.en: Why is "WHERE city = NULL" a mistake?

options.en: NULL is unknown, so = is never true; use IS NULL
options.hi: NULL अज्ञात है, तो = कभी सच नहीं; IS NULL इस्तेमाल करो
options.hinglish: NULL unknown hai, to = kabhi sach nahi; IS NULL use karo

explain.en: Comparisons with NULL give unknown, which WHERE treats as false.
explain.hi: NULL से तुलना अज्ञात देती है, जिसे WHERE झूठ मानता है।
explain.hinglish: NULL se comparison unknown deta hai, jise WHERE false maanta hai.
